_status: Core's own tool (docs/roadmap/jev.md J2): a workflow's Decide step, core.ai.decide. Only core calls it, as the organisation's workflow (a service actor); no product does.
_core: Asked of Jev (tier jev) as one System One request: state = the fields, one 'Label: value' line each; a choice's criteria are its options' keys -> 'label — description'; a score's are its levels in order; a noul's are {true, false} when the step says what yes and no mean. A score answers its level counted from 1 (round of TypeSafe's position, plus 1) and that position from 1 as score; a noul answers yes at p >= 0.5, its confidence the probability of the answer given, max(p, 1 - p), and p_yes. Confidences are kept to two decimals.
